Add plugins to happyview.toml and happyview.lock and download them; with none, bring the lock up to
date and download it

Usage: hpy happyview add [OPTIONS] [PLUGIN]...

Arguments:
  [PLUGIN]...  A language id (interpreters) or a namespace or project name (libraries)

Options:
      --interpreter        Treat every PLUGIN as an interpreter
      --json               Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --library            Treat every PLUGIN as a library
      --no-input           Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still
                           need --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>                 Run as if started in DIR
      --channel <CHANNEL>  Follow this channel: latest, beta or alpha (default: latest, else the
                           only channel there is)
      --version <VERSION>  Pin this exact version instead of following a channel
      --project <AT-URI>   The registry project to use, when several answer to one name
  -h, --help               Print help
